long_biography.plain_text:
Beinke moved from Fort Lauderdale to Northern California in 1975, joining a partnership group that included Ken Behring to develop the 5,000-acre Blackhawk Ranch. The project became Blackhawk Country Club and established a template linking housing, recreation and commercial amenities. Blackhawk later applied that approach to Canyon Lakes, the Summerset active-adult communities and the Vineyards at Marsh Creek.

Across those ventures, Beinke has worked through property partnerships spanning housing, retail, offices and golf-led communities. His industry roles have included the Building Industry Association, Urban Land Institute and International Council of Shopping Centers. Beyond development, he has led the Global Health and Education Foundation and Behring Educational Institute, and previously served as a minority owner and board member of the Seattle Seahawks.
